title: To: Marketing Department · From: Office Manager · Subject: Office move
L: As you know, the marketing department will move to the fifth floor next week.
Movers will arrive on Thursday at 6:00 P.M.
Before you leave on Thursday, please remove all personal items from your desk and put them in the boxes provided.
Please label each box with your name and new desk number.
Computers will be moved by the IT team, so please do not pack them yourself.
On Friday morning, the new offices will be ready, and you can continue your work as usual.
Thank you for your patience during the move.

exq.why: please + động từ nguyên mẫu: please remove (dọn hết đồ khỏi bàn).

exq.a: Please label each box with your name and new desk number.
w: Please pack your computer in the same box as your personal items.
The movers arrived last Thursday and finished the job.
Boxes will not be provided, so please bring your own.
exq.why: Câu chèn tiếp tục hướng dẫn đóng thùng (dán nhãn thùng). Tự đóng máy tính ngược với câu sau; thợ đã chuyển xong ngược với "tuần sau"; tự mang thùng ngược với "boxes provided".
can + động từ nguyên mẫu: can continue (vẫn làm việc tiếp được).
your + danh từ: your patience (sự kiên nhẫn).
